A: used before a noun to refer to a single unspecified thing
AN: the form of 'a' used before a vowel sound
THE: used to point to a specific noun already known or identified
I: the person who is speaking or writing
ME: the objective form of the pronoun 'I'
MY: belonging to or associated with the speaker
MINE: the one or ones belonging to me
WE: the speaker together with one or more others
US: the objective form of the pronoun 'we'
OUR: belonging to or associated with the speakers
YOU: the person or people being addressed
YOUR: belonging to or associated with the person addressed
YOURS: the one or ones belonging to you
HE: a male person or animal previously mentioned
HIM: the objective form of the pronoun 'he'
HIS: belonging to or associated with a male person
SHE: a female person or animal previously mentioned
HER: the objective form of 'she'; belonging to a female
HERS: the one or ones belonging to her
IT: a thing previously mentioned or easily identified
ITS: belonging to or associated with a thing
THEY: two or more people or things previously mentioned
THEM: the objective form of the pronoun 'they'
THEIR: belonging to or associated with the people or things mentioned
WHO: what or which person or people
WHOM: the objective form of the pronoun 'who'
WHOSE: belonging to or associated with which person
THIS: the thing or person nearby or just mentioned
THAT: the thing or person farther away or already mentioned
WHICH: asking for a choice among a set of things
OF: expressing the relationship between a part and a whole
TO: expressing motion or direction toward a point
IN: expressing the situation of being enclosed or within
ON: in contact with and supported by a surface
AT: expressing location or a point in space or time
BY: identifying the agent performing an action
UP: toward a higher place or position
AS: to the same degree; in the role of
FOR: in favor of or intended to benefit someone
FROM: indicating the starting point of a movement
WITH: accompanied by or in the company of
INTO: expressing movement toward the inside of something
ONTO: moving to a position on the surface of something
OFF: away from a place or a surface
OUT: away from the inside or center
OVER: extending directly upward from or across
AND: used to connect words or clauses together
NOR: used to introduce a further negative statement
SO: to such a great extent; therefore
ARE: second person singular and plural present of 'be'
WAS: first and third person singular past of 'be'
WERE: second person singular and plural past of 'be'
BE: to exist or to have a specified quality
BEING: present participle of 'be'; a living thing
DO: to perform or carry out an action
CAN: to be able to do something
WOULD: past tense of 'will'; expressing a conditional
SHALL: expressing the future or a strong intention
NOT: used to make a word or statement negative
NO: used to give a negative response
YES: used to give an affirmative response
OK: used to express agreement or acceptance
OKAY: used to express agreement or acceptance
THEN: at that time; next in order
LEFT: past tense of 'leave'; the opposite of right
PEOPLE: human beings in general or considered collectively
RUNG: past participle of 'ring'; a bar on a ladder
SPOKE: past tense of 'speak'; a bar of a wheel
BROKE: past tense of 'break'; having no money
WORN: past participle of 'wear'; damaged by use
BORE: past tense of 'bear'; to make weary
BIT: past tense of 'bite'; a small piece
SHOT: past tense of 'shoot'; a firing of a gun
